svg.title: Mesoscope event-amplitude signal quality
svg.desc: A raw trace and B individual footprint; C-E archived event fractions; F one VISp field of view; G all 175,508 cohort ROIs; H shared area, depth, and mouse compositions; I all 81 sessions from 10 mice, with mouse medians. Three archived quality classes are retained without refitting.
